description: Fork of exp611 (1.4048 hybrid_smooth n_alt=1 SoTA) architecture, but replace ALL TinyMultiHeadLut(backward_mode=hybrid_smooth) modules with SoftMultiHeadLUT(hamming_1_mask=True, hard=False). Mathematically: same (NAP+1)-way softmax over Hamming-1 ball as exp612 (full ball), but computed via matmul + finite mask (-1e4 outside ball). Backward via autograd → SELF-CONSISTENT gradients (no soft K-row surrogate): grad_x flows ONLY through the (NAP+1) ball rows via abs_p → ts → masked_softmax → probs chain. Equivalence test: this approach matches gather-based (NAP+1)-row forward to within fp32 precision but is 3.7x FASTER (one matmul vs NAP+1 gather+multiply+add ops). Tests user hypothesis: if backward is self-consistent with the actual (NAP+1)-row forward (not the K-row surrogate from exp612), the result might be better.
